newsitem.title: UK: All four Brent cargoes kept voluntarily - trade.
newsitem.headline: All four Brent cargoes kept voluntarily - trade.

text.p: All four Brent cargoes nominated loading dates on Friday were kept voluntarily ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
Shell UK kept a May 17-19 cargo, while Shell's Stasco kept a May 18-20 loader.
Another cargo loading May 18-20 was kept by Esso. Elf kept the fourth cargo, due to load May 19-21, traders said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
